title: scale a run of f32 by 4096 and truncate to i32 through the client's integer bit path (saturating)
notes: Read from 0x141c6c830 (145 bytes, 3 pieces, no callees, no global reads).

Sign is applied after the magnitude path: (magnitude ^ -sign) - -sign. Saturation therefore produces i32::MAX and -i32::MAX; i32::MIN is unreachable, which the first draft of the note got wrong and the differential did not have to catch because the code was transcribed faithfully.
The loop bound is the count argument, not the buffer length; the fixture always ties them so the client's missing bounds check cannot fault.

Declared cases pin the shift boundaries: 2048.0 (exponent 138, shift 0 both sides), 2^19 (shift 8, saturate), 2^19-1ulp, 1e-5 and the subnormals (shift > 23 -> 0), +-inf and NaN, and count = 0 for the early exit.
Equivalent mutant: `>=` -> `>` on `exponent >= 138` cannot be observed, because at exponent 138 the left and right shifts are both by zero.

knownEquivalentMutants.detail: exponent >= 138 vs > 138: at exponent 138 both arms shift by 0
